items: 营业执照已上传并审核通过
类目所需特殊资质已备齐（食品经营许可证/化妆品备案/3C认证等）
商标注册证或授权书（品牌商品必须）
items_en: Business license uploaded and approved
Special category qualifications ready (food license / cosmetics filing / 3C, etc.)
Trademark certificate or authorization (required for branded goods)

items: 标题不含违禁词（最/第一/国家级等极限词）
主图为实拍或授权图，不含水印/其他平台logo
描述与实物一致，不夸大功能
价格真实，不标虚高原价再打折
SKU属性填写完整
items_en: Title contains no prohibited words (e.g. best, No.1, national-level)
Main images are real or licensed, with no watermark or other platform logos
Description matches the product without exaggerating features
Prices are genuine (no inflated original price before a discount)
SKU attributes filled in completely

items: 运费模板设置正确（偏远地区加价或不发货）
发货时效承诺明确（48小时/72小时）
退换货政策符合平台规定
破损/丢件赔付规则清晰
items_en: Shipping templates set correctly (surcharge or exclusion for remote regions)
Clear delivery-time promise (48h / 72h)
Return and refund policy follows platform rules
Clear compensation rules for damage or loss

items: 产品不含目标国禁售品类（锂电池需MSDS/UN38.3）
已确认目标国关税和VAT缴纳方式
产品标签符合当地语言要求
外观/专利不侵权
包装符合运输标准（易碎品标识）
items_en: Product is not prohibited in the target country (lithium batteries need MSDS/UN38.3)
Confirmed how duties and VAT are handled in the target country
Product labels meet local language requirements
No design or patent infringement
Packaging meets shipping standards (fragile markings)

crossborder: 锂电池（需MSDS+UN38.3，部分渠道拒收）
化妆品（需成分检测报告）
crossborder_en: Lithium batteries (need MSDS + UN38.3; some channels reject them)

review_checklist.title: 每日运营检查清单
items: 回复全部买家消息（响应时间影响权重）
处理待发货订单（48小时内）
检查差评并处理
监控广告花费和ACOS
查看竞品价格变动
检查库存预警
记录当日数据（访客/转化/销售额）
items_en: Reply to all buyer messages (response time affects ranking)
Process orders to ship (within 48 hours)
Check and handle negative reviews
Monitor ad spend and ACOS
Watch competitor price changes
Check inventory alerts
Record the day's data (visitors / conversions / sales)
